01 / THE AUTHORITY BOUNDARY

Permission is an
economic state.

Numina evaluates a proposed transition against existing rights, occupied capacity, dependency state, and the Constitution.

Authentication establishes identity. Economic authorization establishes what that identity may commit, under which bounds and dependencies. Recognition can narrow that authority. Measurement and optimization cannot create it.

Before action

Bind the credential to one operation, its authority bounds, dependency closure and Constitution identity.

At commitment

Re-check authority and serialize the transition. Preserve nonce uniqueness and a durable receipt.

After uncertainty

Keep unknown effects occupied until evidence narrows the possible outcome. Recovery cannot manufacture authority.

02 / THE CURRENT BUILD

From constitutional kernel
to systemic stability.

The supplied Core v1.8 reference includes rights genesis and occupancy, institutional compilation, governed contracting, recognition networks, constitutional markets, margin state, default waterfalls and non-amplifying recovery.

The web adapter exposes signed reference EAC verification, observational margin assessment, and a separate durable simulation gateway. All activity is synthetic. The full Python runtime is not deployed as a financial execution service.
